steps: Sign up as a participant at playbookux.com and pass the unpaid practice test.
Qualify for a moderated study via profile/screener matching.
Schedule and attend the live 30/60/90-minute Zoom interview with the researcher.
Receive $30/$60/$90 via PayPal within 8 days of completing the session.
timing: Payment via PayPal within 8 days of completing the study (official FAQ).

repeatable.cadence: moderated interview invitations come whenever your profile matches a study — slots are limited and scheduled — and you can attend each one you qualify for

maximize: Complete your profile fully to match moderated interview screeners. When invited, lock in the Zoom slot and show up on time — no-shows mean no pay. A 30-minute moderated interview pays $30, 60 minutes pays $60, 90 minutes pays $90, all via PayPal within 8 days of completion. Participate actively; poor participation disqualifies payment.
who_pays: PlaybookUX pays you via PayPal automatically after each study. There’s no payout threshold — track payments in the ‘Completed Tests’ tab.
who_qualifies: Anyone — matched by profile and screener. You need the Zoom app on desktop, iOS or Android, a quiet room, and scheduled availability for the live 30/60/90-minute interview.
work_available: Invite-based, and moderated slots are scarcer than unmoderated ones — frequency depends on profile/screener matching.
what_gets_accepted: You must schedule and attend the live Zoom interview at the agreed time and participate actively. No-shows or poor participation mean no pay.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join, no fees. Unpaid time: the practice test must be approved first; you also spend unpaid time qualifying through screeners and scheduling each session.
when_cash_arrives: Via PayPal within 8 days of completing the study.
